message.content: The review board is considering whether to close the leak-testing row for valve V31. Claim A that V31 was in lot R8 is contradicted by inspection records placing it in lot R6. Claim B that V31 passed a helium leak test at 3 bar remains unresolved because the QA email mentions a 3-bar test but does not confirm the gas used, and the archived gas field is blank. Claim C that V31 underwent a nitrogen test is well supported by rig output records. Given the uncertainty about the helium test and confirmed nitrogen test, the board should be cautious about closing the helium leak test row without further verification of the test gas used.
